bookSourceComment:
// Error: 源地址不是http链接

─────当前版本Pro V50─────
点击登录即可查看:
0、书源制作思路
1、版本更新日志
2、书源用法展示
3、相关问题解释
───────搜索格式────────
完全格式：书名#作者$网站
简化格式1：书名$网站
简化格式2：书名#作者
简化格式3：书名
说明：搜索“斗破苍穹#天蚕土豆$www.qidian.com”将在“www.qidian.com”中搜索名为斗破苍穹、作者为天蚕土豆的书籍
──────前缀设置全体───────
用法：“单跳逆原动静字图”等字后跟“^”再跟“搜索关键字”，可实现这些字对应的功能。
范围：本次搜索到的所有书籍都会执行指定的功能。
示例：“图^斗破苍穹”、“逆静^斗破苍穹#天蚕土豆”、“跳^斗破苍穹$www.qidian.com”。
─────⤵
跳：允许目录自动跳转，目录标题说点击跳转时可如此做。
逆：设置书籍目录章节逆向排序，配合指定网站的搜索方式针对小说全是逆向排序的网站比较方便。
原：设置书籍不进行净化替换，优点是加载正文快速且不会被误删内容，缺点是需要自己写“替换净化”规则并在正文中启用才能净化网站推广文本。
动：强制设置正文动态加载(正文默认会进行需要动态加载还是静态加载的判断，然后自动切换模式，若判断失误导致本应切换成动态加载却未切换时，可强制设置正文动态加载)。
静：强制设置正文静态加载(正文默认会进行需要动态加载还是静态加载的判断，然后自动切换模式，若判断失误导致本应保持静态加载却切换成动态加载而使正文加载时间变长时，可强制设置正文静态加载)。
图：设置成看图模式(不设置则默认图文模式)，只显示图片，不显示文字。
字：设置成纯字模式(不设置则默认图文模式)，只显示文本，不显示图片。
─────⤴
──────书籍变量设置───────
用法：
将“单直跳全逆原图字动静”中任意多个字
或“[目录url]”或“[正文尾页url]单”
或“数字#第二页链接#”
或“[目录尾页url]录”
放在详情页右上角的书籍变量中，
确认后点刷新就能触发这些字段对应的功能。
范围：只控制当前书籍执行指定功能。
书籍变量格式示范：[http://m.biquku.la/0/425/]全字
─────⤵
直：不做目录识别，直接将详情页作为目录页，或以“[目录链接]”格式直接指定目录链接，目录识别错误时可这种做。
全：直接显示“预览正文”和查询到的所有章节，跳过章节筛选环节，单页文章和部分筛选后章节不全的小说网站可这样做。
─────⤴
──目录有分页却无翻页按钮或书籍无目录──
单：无目录打开即正文但有尾页或下一页按钮的书籍，必须设置为单向模式，这样书源会直接将入口页作为正文第一页，并将第一页及其所有下一页共同构造生成“正文1”、“正文2”…的目录形式来阅读，搜索前缀“单^”、书籍变量“单”。
录：有目录分页但无目录下一页按钮的书籍，可在书籍变量中直接指定复制到的最后目录页链接为目录链接并添加指令“录”，即可自动生成所有目录分页。
书籍变量：“[https://m.zuizaoxiaoshuo.com/ml/33280_13]录”
辅助生成──无目录打开即正文也无尾页和下一页按钮的书籍，需指定章节数量并用第二页链接作为参考链接生成所有分页。
书籍变量──220#https://wap.yqshuwang.com/2021n/02/14972_2.html#
效果说明──根据第二页链接“https://wap.yqshuwang.com/2021n/02/14972_2.html”生成220条章节的目录列表。
单个章节──目录仅一个章节且这个章节正文中无下一页按钮时，可复制那个章节的正文尾页链接并用指令“单”，便可将所有正文分页构造成章节列表。

<js>
var bes = result.match(/PHA\+[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+={0,2}/g);
//java.log(String(bes))
if (!bes) {
    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString(".word_read@p@text",ml);
    java.toast("正文解密失败，转为webView动态加载。");
} else {
var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {
    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
	var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;
</js>

    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

try{
let all = [];

let 收起符 = "↑ ";

//一行个数
let numy = 3;

    1: 1,

    3: 0.25,
    4: 0.2,
    5: 0.15,
    7: 0.1,
    10: 0.05
};

let num = d[numy];
let push = (title, url, num, g,action) =>{
	let j = {
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
        layout_flexGrow: g == 0 ? g : 1,
        layout_flexBasisPercent: num
    }
  }
     if(action){
         j.action = action.action;
         j.name = action.name;
         j.type = action.type;
         j.chars = action.chars;
         j.viewName = action.viewName;
         j.default = action.default;      
     }     
     all.push(j)	
} 

function zwf(len,numy,num){
	if(len%numy!==0){
        let n = len % numy;
        let p = numy-n;
      
        for(let i=0;i<p;i++){
            push(占位符, ``, num, 1,{"type":"button","action":"java.toast('这是占位符')"});
        }
    }
}
let navdata = java.ajax("https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav")
let mid = JSON.parse(navdata)?.data?.mid || "";
let searchOrder = changeSearch();

push("搜索类型", "", searchOrder.length?0.4:1,1,{
        "type": "select",

        "chars":["🏷综合","👤用户","🎥视频","📖专栏","🎞影视","📽番剧","📺直播"],

    });

    push("搜索排序", "", 0.4,1,{

        "action":"show(infoMap['搜索排序'],'searchorder')",
        "chars":searchOrder,
        "default": Map("searchorder")||"综合排序"
    });
    }
    push("搜索关键词", "",d["2"],1,{
        "type": "text",
        "viewName":"'搜索关键词： '+Map('searchk')",
        "action":"show(infoMap['搜索关键词'],'searchk',1)",
        "default":Map("searchk")
    });
    push("🔍搜索", "", d["5"],1,{
    	    "action":"toSearch()",

    });
push("👤我的", "", 1);
push("推送视频", "https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/index/top/feed/rcmd", num);
push("热门视频", "https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/popular?pn={\{page}}", num);
push("入站必刷", "https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/popular/precious", num);

var result = [];

    // 遍历数组，使用阅读内置Base64解码方法

      }
	var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;

<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util
);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}
String(decrypt(JSON.parse(result).DATA.CTXT)).replace(/{{title}}/,'')
</js>

<js>
$=result;

intro=$.chapterintro;
vip=$.isvip!='0';
lock=$.islock!='0';
type=$.chaptertype=='1'?true:false;
num=!type?$.chapterid+"  ☪ ":'';

//下面被注释的代码是已经有章节数的前面就不加序号了
bbb = book.getVariable("custom");
sss = source.getVariable();
if(/去章节序号/.test(bbb) || /去章节序号/.test(sss)){
num=''
}else{num=num}

title=type?'📖 '+title+' 📖':title;
if( (/目录简介/.test(bbb) || /目录简介/.test(sss))&&!/📖/.test(title)){
	title = title + " ❖ "+intro
	}else{
		title = title
		java.put("intro1",intro);
		}
v=vip&&!type?' ◇':'';
l=lock?'[此章节已锁]':'';
result=num+title+l+v;
</js>

<js>
var bes = result.match(/PHA\+[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+={0,2}/g);
//java.log(String(bes))
if (!bes) {
    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString("#txt@html");
    java.longToast("正文解密失败，转为webView动态加载。");
} else {
var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {
    // 遍历数组，使用阅读内置Base64解码方法
    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
	var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;
</js>

    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,

);

with(javaImport){
    function decrypt(str){
        var key=SecretKeySpec(String("1701019k").getBytes(),"DES");
        var iv=IvParameterSpec(java.base64DecodeToByteArray("AQIDBAUGBwg="));
        var bytes=Base64.decode(String(str).getBytes(),2);
        var chipher=Cipher.getInstance("DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        chipher.init(2,key,iv);
        return String(chipher.doFinal(bytes));
    }
}

<js>
bid = java.base64Decode(baseUrl.split(",")[1]);
//java.log(bid)
result = java.ajax(buildRequest(`${backend}/69/catalog?book_id=${bid}`));

JSON.parse(result).list.reduce((arr, item) => {
    title = item.chaptername;
    url = item.articleid + "/" + item.chapterid;
    arr.push(
        JSON.stringify({
            title,
            url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(url)},{"type":"my69c"}`,
        })
    );
    return arr;
}, []);
</js>

function qmDecryptChapterBytes(value) {
  var raw = Packages.android.util.Base64.decode(String(value), 0)
  if (!raw || raw.length <= 16) throw new Error('七猫章节密文无效')
  var iv = Packages.java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 0, 16)
  var encrypted = Packages.java.util.Arrays.copyOfRange(raw, 16, raw.length)
  var key = new Packages.javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(new Packages.java.lang.String(QM_AES_KEY).getBytes('UTF-8'), 'AES')
  var ivSpec = new Packages.javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(iv)
  var cipher = Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance('AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding')
  cipher.init(2, key, ivSpec)
  return cipher.doFinal(encrypted)
}

function qmDecodeTextBytes(bytes) {
  if (!bytes) return ''
  var charset = 'UTF-8'
  try {
    var headSize = Math.min(Number(bytes.length || 0), 512)
    var head = String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, 0, headSize, 'ISO-8859-1'))
    var match = head.match(/(?:encoding|charset)\s*=\s*["']?\s*([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)/i)
    if (match && match[1]) charset = String(match[1])
    var b0 = Number(bytes[0]) & 255
    var b1 = Number(bytes[1]) & 255
    if (b0 == 255 && b1 == 254) charset = 'UTF-16LE'
    else if (b0 == 254 && b1 == 255) charset = 'UTF-16BE'
  } catch (detectError) {}
  try {
    return String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, charset)).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
  } catch (charsetError) {
    return String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, 'UTF-8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
  }
}

function qmDecryptChapter(value) {
  var bytes = qmDecryptChapterBytes(value)
  if (bytes.length > 3 && (Number(bytes[0]) & 255) == 80 && (Number(bytes[1]) & 255) == 75) {
    throw new Error('EPUB 已改为服务器解密，请配置服务地址并刷新书籍目录')

}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {

  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {

    if (!seen[key]) {

  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {

function qmDateText(value) {
  var seconds = Number(value || 0)
  if (!seconds) return ''
  var date = new Date(seconds > 9999999999 ? seconds : seconds * 1000)
  function two(number) { return number < 10 ? '0' + number : String(number) }
  return date.getFullYear() + '-' + two(date.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + two(date.getDate()) + ' ' + two(date.getHours()) + ':' + two(date.getMinutes())
}

function qmNovelInfo(raw) {
  raw = raw || {}

  Object.keys(raw).forEach(function (key) { info[key] = raw[key] })
  var tags = (raw.book_tag_list || []).map(function (x) { return String(x.title || '') }).filter(function (x) { return !!x })
  var attribute = raw.attribute || {}
  var extras = attribute.extra_info_list || []
  function findExtra(pattern) {
    for (var i = 0; i < extras.length; i++) {
      if (pattern.test(String(extras[i].sub_title || extras[i].title || ''))) return qmExtraInfoText(extras[i])
    }
    return ''
  }
  var score = attribute.score || findExtra(/评分|评价/)
  if (score && String(score).indexOf('分') < 0) score = String(score) + '分'
  var reading = ''
  var readingList = attribute.reading_info_list || []
  if (readingList.length > 2) reading = qmExtraInfoText(readingList[2]) || String(readingList[2].title || readingList[2].text || '')
  if (!reading) reading = findExtra(/正在阅读|在线/)
  var lines = []
  var updated = qmDateText(raw.update_time)
  if (updated) lines.push('🧭 更新：' + updated)
  if (raw.category_over_words) lines.push('📒 关于：' + raw.category_over_words)
  if (score) lines.push('💯 分数：' + score)
  if (reading) lines.push('👁️ 在线：' + reading)
  if (tags.length) lines.push('🏷️ 标签：' + tags.join(' / '))
  if (raw.characters) lines.push('👥 角色：' + raw.characters)
  if (raw.publisher) lines.push('🏢 出版：' + raw.publisher)
  if (raw.isbn) lines.push('🔖 ISBN：' + raw.isbn)
  var copyright = raw.statement || raw.source_name
  if (copyright) lines.push('📍 版权来源：' + copyright)
  if (raw.intro) lines.push('📄 简介：' + raw.intro)
  info.id = String(raw.id || '')
  info.author = raw.author || raw.author_name || ''
  info.image_link = raw.big_image_link || raw.image_link || raw.thumb_image_link || ''
  info.intro = lines.join('\n')
  info.kind = [raw.category_over_words].concat(tags).filter(function (x) { return !!x }).join(',')
  info.last_chapter = raw.latest_chapter_title || raw.chapter_list_desc || ''
  info.words_num = raw.words_num || raw.word_count || ''
  return info
}

  } else {

  }

loginUrl:
<js>
  function login() {
    const user = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号"))
    const pw = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码"))
    let sign = java.md5Encode(`isDevice=Android&password=${pw}&phone=${user}&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    let data = JSON.stringify({
      isDevice: "Android",
      password: pw,
      phone: user,
      regDevice: "2",
      sign: sign
    })
    let op = JSON.stringify({
      method: "POST",
      body: data
    })
    let res = java.ajax(`https://api.shaoniandream.com/Login/login,${op}`)
    let $ = JSON.parse(res)
    if($.status != 1) java.toast($.msg)
    java.put("uid",$.data.id)
    source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify({
      logintoken: $.data.logintoken
    }))
  }
</js>

                allSourceOptions.push({

                });

                    sourceNameToType[item.name] = item.type;

} catch(e) {

<js>
function getBookIdFull(url) {
    const {java} = this;
    let $ = JSON.parse(url).data;
    let arr = [];
    if ($.book_shelf_info && $.book_shelf_info.length > 0) {
        arr = $.book_shelf_info.map(item => item.book_id);
    } else if ($.data_list && $.data_list.length > 0) {
        arr = $.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str);
    } else {
        java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！");
    }
    return arr;
}

let session = getSessionId()

getShelf = () => {
    let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/book_shelf?session=" + session)
    
    bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
    
    let id_list = splitArray(bid, 200)
    let urls = []
    id_list.forEach(i => {
        urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
    let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/book_shelf?session=" + session))
    
    let group_bookids = {
        "未分组": []
    }
    book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
        if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
        group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
    })
    
    if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
    
    let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 200)
    let urls = []

    book_ids.forEach(i => { 	urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
    let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
        "bookmall/tab",
        "version_name=5.8.9.32",
        null,
        "sessionid=" + session
    )
    let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
    let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
    if (!tab) tab = []
    let bookList = []
    for (let i of tab) {
        bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
    return { book_info: bookList }
}

function getGuessYouLike() {
    let apiUrl = 'https://reading.snssdk.com/reading/bookapi/bookmall/tab/v/?version_name=5.8.9.32&device_id=1024&device_type=114514&iid=2048&aid=1967&channel=0&os_version=0&app_name=novelapp&version_code=58932&device_platform=android'
    let response = java.ajax(apiUrl + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
        headers: {
            'Cookie': "sessionid=" + session
        }
    }))
    let responseData = JSON.parse(response)
    let finalResult = {
        code: 0,
        message: 'SUCCESS',
        data: {
            cell_view: {
                book_data: []
            }
        }
    }
    if (responseData.data && responseData.data.tab_item && responseData.data.tab_item.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data) {
        finalResult.data.cell_view.book_data = responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data
    }
    return finalResult
}

function normalizeResponse(data) {
    if (data.data && data.data.book_list && Array.isArray(data.data.book_list)) {
        return data.data.book_list;
    }
    
    if (data.book_info) return data.book_info;
    if (data.data && data.data.book_info) return data.data.book_info;
    if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
    if (data.list) return data.list;
    if (data.book_list) return data.book_list;
    if (data.data && data.data.publication_list) return data.data.publication_list;
    if (data.result) return data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.result) return data.data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.cell_view && data.data.cell_view.book_data) {
        return data.data.cell_view.book_data;
    }
    if (data.data && data.data.records) return data.data.records;
    if (data.data && data.data.list) return data.data.list;
    
    return [];
}

if (baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let decodedToken = java.base64Decode(JJtoken());
    let timestamp = Date.now();
    let enbody = timestamp + ':' + decodedToken;
    let encodedEnbody = encode(enbody);
    
    let signUrl = "https://app.jjwxc.org/androidapi/signin,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"versionCode=313&sign=" + encodedEnbody + "\"}";
    
    let signinResult = java.ajax(signUrl);
    
    let result = JSON.parse(signinResult);
    let message = result.message || "签到请求完成";
    
    let responseData = {
        "isSuccess": result.code == "200",
        "errorMsg": result.code == "200" ? "success" : "fail",
        "data": [{
            "title": message
        }]
    };
    
    JSON.stringify(responseData);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf")) {
    let token = JJtoken();
    let jjUrl = baseUrl + token;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(jjUrl));
    JSON.stringify(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("type_style")) {
    let sortKey = getSortKey() || '';
    let newUrl = baseUrl + sortKey;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(newUrl));
    
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData});
} else if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) {
    result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
} else if(/read_history/.test(baseUrl)) {
    let pageMatch = baseUrl.match(/page=(\d+)/);
    let page = pageMatch ? pageMatch[1] : '1';
    
    let history_response = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/read_history?session=" + session + "&page=" + page)
    let history_data = JSON.parse(history_response)
    
    if (history_data.data.data_list) {
        let book_ids = history_data.data.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str)
        
        let id_list = splitArray(book_ids, 200)
        let urls = []
        id_list.forEach(i => {
          urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
        })
        
        let resp = {book_info: []}
        urls.forEach(url => {
            let detailResponse = java.ajax(url)
            let detailData = JSON.parse(detailResponse)
            if (detailData.data) {
                resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(detailData.data)
            }
        })
        
        result = resp
    } else {
        result = {book_info: []}
    }
} else if (baseUrl.includes("style_top")) {
    result = JSON.parse(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("/tab/cai")) {
    result = getGuessYouLike();
} else {
    let w = baseUrl.split("/")
    if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
        result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
    } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
        result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
    } else {
        result = JSON.parse(result)
        if (result.data && result.data.data) {
            result = {book_info: result.data.data}
        }
    }
}

if (!baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf") && !baseUrl.includes("type_style") && !baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData})
}
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var html = String(result);
var doc = Packages.org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
var nr = doc.selectFirst('article#nr');
var lines = [];
if (nr) {
    var rawHtml = String(nr.html());
    rawHtml = rawHtml.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n');
    var parts = rawHtml.split('\n');
    for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
        var line = parts[i].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '').replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (line) {
            if (/最新网址|m\.biqukun|本章未完.*继续阅读/.test(line)) continue;
            lines.push(line);
        }
    }
    if (lines.length > 0 && /^第\d+章/.test(lines[0])) {
        lines.shift();
    }
}
lines.join('\n');
</js>

bookSourceComment:
五八书阁（m.5859ycdh.com）
免费小说阅读网站，无需登录，无搜索次数限制。
【技术实现】
搜索：POST /search/（body: q={{key}}），不支持分页
发现：分类目录（/wuba131/~139/）+ 书库 + 排行榜 + 完本
  - 分类/书库/排行榜支持 ?page={{page}} 分页
  - 完本不支持分页（固定100本）
详情：/wuba/{bookId}/ CSS 选择器
目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html（全量章节，无分页）
正文：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html（章节内分页，#PageSet）
【URL 规律】
书籍详情：/wuba/{bookId}/
章节目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html
正文页面：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html
正文分页：{chapterId}-{pageNum}.html
【规则语法说明】
- 详情页：用 Default规则语法(class.B@tag.dd.1@...) 和 CSS类选择器(span.ml, span.c)
- 发现/搜索页：用 Default规则语法(tag.dd.1@...)，因为CSS选择器不支持数字索引
- 发现页 dl.B（大卡片）和 dl.S（小卡片）共存，bookList 用逗号合并
- 部分页面图片使用 data-src 懒加载，已用 || 兼容
- 正文末尾有广告文本，已用正则清理
- 正文有内分页，已配置 nextContentUrl
- 编码：UTF-8

  if (source.getLoginInfoMap() == null) {

  try {

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
list = [];
data = JSON.parse(src).data;
chargeContUrlPrefix = data.chargeContUrlPrefix;
freeContUrlPrefix = data.freeContUrlPrefix;
shortContUrlPrefix = data.shortContUrlPrefix;
chapterList = data.chapterList;
var sqMetaMap = {};
var sqShortMap = {};
var sqCatalogBookId = "";
try { sqCatalogBookId = String(bookId || ""); } catch(e) {}
if (!sqCatalogBookId) {
  var sqBookMatch = String(baseUrl || "").match(/bookId=(\d+)/);
  if (sqBookMatch) sqCatalogBookId = sqBookMatch[1];
}
function sqFmtCatalogTime(ts) {
  var d = new Date(Number(ts || 0) * 1000);
  if (!Number(ts || 0)) return "";
  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }
  return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()) + " " + pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes());
}
for (i in chapterList) {
  volumeName = chapterList[i].volumeName;
  list.push({ chapterName: "🏮〖" + volumeName + "〗🏮", isVolume: true });
  chapterList[i].volumeList.forEach($ => {
    var suffix = String($.contUrlSuffix || "");
    var realChapterUrl = ($.isFreeRead ? freeContUrlPrefix : chargeContUrlPrefix) + suffix;
    realChapterUrl = String(realChapterUrl || "").replace(/0$/, "1");
    var currentBookId = String(sqCatalogBookId || "");
    var currentChapterId = String($.chapterId || "");
    chapterUrl = realChapterUrl;
    shortUrl = shortContUrlPrefix + String($.shortContUrlSuffix || "");
    time = sqFmtCatalogTime($.chapterUpdateTime);
    wordCount = $.wordCount + "字";
    chapterPrice = $.chapterPrice != "0" && !$.isFreeRead ? $.chapterPrice + "书豆" : "";
    if (suffix) {
      sqMetaMap[suffix] = { bookId: currentBookId, chapterId: currentChapterId };
      if (shortUrl) sqShortMap[suffix] = shortUrl;
    }
    list.push({
      chapterName: $.chapterName,
      chapterUrl: chapterUrl,
      isVip: !$.isFreeRead,
      isPay: $.isBuy,
      chapterInfo: [volumeName, time, wordCount, chapterPrice].join("丨").replace(/丨$/, "")
    });
  });
}
try {
  java.put("sqMetaMap", JSON.stringify(sqMetaMap));
  java.put("sqShortMap", JSON.stringify(sqShortMap));
  _sqMetaMapCache = null;
  _sqShortMapCache = null;
} catch(eMap) {}

var javaImporter = new JavaImporter();
javaImporter.importPackage(
    Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util
);
with (javaImporter) {
    function decode(content) {
        var ivEncryptedData = Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(content));
        var secretKey = SecretKeySpec(String("242ccb8230d709e1").getBytes(), "AES");
        var ivParameter = IvParameterSpec(Arrays.copyOfRange(ivEncryptedData, 0, 16));
        var cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
        cipher.init(2, secretKey, ivParameter);
        return String(cipher.doFinal(Arrays.copyOfRange(ivEncryptedData, 16, ivEncryptedData.length)));
    }
}

const signKey = "d3dGiJc651gSQ8w1";

var params = {
    "id": String(java.get("bid")),
    "chapterId": String(baseUrl.split("/").pop())
};

    if (paramType == "string" || paramType == "number" || paramType == "boolean") {
        paramStr += "&" + key + "=" + ((encode == null || encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);

    return paramStr;
};

paramSign = String(java.md5Encode(

));
params["sign"] = paramSign;

time = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000).toString()

function getSign (key, type, num) {
  const { java } = this
  const secret = 'magic2019'
  let baseString

  switch (type) {
    case 's':
      baseString = `channel=ft0001&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=0&query=${java.encodeURI(key)}&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 't':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&gid=1&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    case 'c':
      baseString = `bid=${key}&channel=ft0001&chapterid=${num}&gid=2&nci=1&nsc=1&timestamp=${time}&secret=${secret}`
      break
    default:
      throw new Error('Invalid type')
  }

  return java.md5Encode(baseString).toUpperCase()
}

<js>
var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(String(result), baseUrl);
var arr = [];
var seen = {};
// 1. 封面推荐卡片 .col-md-6.mb-3
var cards = doc.select(".col-md-6.mb-3");
for(var i=0;i<cards.size();i++){
  var card = cards.get(i);
  var titleA = card.select("h6.book-title a").first();
  if(titleA == null) continue;
  var url = titleA.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = titleA.text().trim();
  var authorEl = card.select("p.book-author").first();
  var author = authorEl ? authorEl.text().replace("作者：","").trim() : "";
  var coverEl = card.select("img.book-cover").first();
  var cover = coverEl ? coverEl.attr("abs:src") : "";
  var introEl = card.select("p.book-desc").first();
  var intro = introEl ? introEl.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:cover, intro:intro});
}
// 2. 最新入库列表 ul.new-book-list li
var newItems = doc.select("ul.new-book-list li");
for(var i=0;i<newItems.size();i++){
  var li = newItems.get(i);
  var a = li.select("a").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var span = li.select("span").first();
  var author = span ? span.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:""});
}
// 3. 编辑推荐列表 ul.latest-list li
var latestItems = doc.select("ul.latest-list li");
for(var i=0;i<latestItems.size();i++){
  var li = latestItems.get(i);
  var a = li.select("a.latest-title").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var span = li.select("span.latest-author").first();
  var author = span ? span.text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:""});
}
// 4. 最近更新表格 table.update-table tbody tr
var rows = doc.select("table.update-table tbody tr");
for(var i=0;i<rows.size();i++){
  var tr = rows.get(i);
  var tds = tr.select("td");
  if(tds.size() < 2) continue;
  var a = tds.get(0).select("a").first();
  if(a == null) continue;
  var url = a.attr("abs:href");
  if(url === "" || seen[url]) continue;
  seen[url] = true;
  var name = a.text().trim();
  var author = tds.get(1).text().trim();
  var lastCh = tds.size() > 2 ? tds.get(2).text().trim() : "";
  if(name !== "") arr.push({name:name, author:author, url:url, coverUrl:"", intro:lastCh});
}
JSON.stringify(arr)
</js>

var arr = baseUrl.split('/');
var songtype = arr[3];
var songid = arr[4].split('.')[0];
/*
var data = java.ajax("http://service.5sing.kugou.com/song/getSongUrl?version=6.6.70&songid=" + songid + "&songtype=" + songtype);
data = JSON.parse(data).data
data.squrl || data.hqurl || data.lqurl;
*/
	
let params = {
  appid: 3146,
  clienttime: Math.ceil(Date.now() / 1000),
  clientver: 610850,
  dfid: "-",
  from: "com.sing.client.player",
  mid: 114514,
  songfields: "ID,SN,SK,SW,SS,ST,SI,CT,M,S,ZQ,WO,ZC,HY,YG,CK,D,RQ,DD,E,R,RC,SG,C,CS,LV,LG,SY,UID,PT,SCSR,SC,KM5",
  songid: songid,
  songtype: songtype,
  token: "",
  userfields: "ID,NN,I,YCRQ,FCRQ",
  uuid: "-"
}

let signstr = ""
let keys = Object.keys(params).sort()
for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
  signstr += `${keys[i]}=${params[keys[i]]}`
}
let signature = java.md5Encode("UqgPMZpjgRZQ7s8JAuUIP5DQdo5O5NB" + signstr + "UqgPMZpjgRZQ7s8JAuUIP5DQdo5O5NB")

let querys = []
for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
  querys.push(`${keys[i]}=${params[keys[i]]}`.replace(/\,/g, "%2c"))
}
let querystr = querys.join("&") + "&signature=" + signature
let request = java.ajax("https://5sapi.kugou.com/song/getSongUrl?" + querystr)
// java.log(request)
let data = JSON.parse(request).data
data.squrl || data.squrl_backup || data.hqurl || data.hqurl_backup || data.lqurl || data.lqurl_backup
</js>

var pages = java.getElements('tag.select@option');
pages = Math.floor(pages.length / 2);
java.log("pages: " + pages);
var res = [];
var set = {}; // 去重

for (let i = 1; i <= pages; i ++) {
  var url = baseUrl.replace('/1/', '/' + i + '/');
  var resp = java.ajax(url);
  java.setContent(resp);
  resp = java.getStringList('//ul[@class="section-list fix ycxsid"]/li/a');

  for (let j = 0; j < resp.length; j ++) {
    var rr = resp[j].match(/<a href="(.*?)">(.*?)<\/a>/);
    var title = rr[2], href = rr[1];
    if (set[title]) continue;
    var order = href.match(/\/(\d+)\.html/)[1];
    res.push(JSON.stringify({ title, href, order }));
    set[title] = true;
  }
}
res.sort((a, b) => {
  a = JSON.parse(a);
  b = JSON.parse(b);
  return a.order - b.order;
});
res;
</js>

	var txt = result.join('\n');
}

  var paramStr = '';

var bookId = baseUrl.match(/(\d+)/)[1]
result = java.ajax("https://wxapp.qidian.com/api/book/categoryV2?bookId=" + bookId + "&_csrfToken=")
var charts = [];
JSON.parse(result).data.vs.map(i => {
    i.cs.map(o => {
        var chart = {
            "id": o.id,
            "title": o.cN,
            "v": o.sS == 0,
            "t": o.uT + "  " + o.cnt + "字"
        }
        var content_url = {
            bookId: bookId,
            id: o.id,
            v: o.sS == 0
        }
        content_url = java.base64Encode(JSON.stringify(content_url));
        chart.url = `data:;base64,${content_url},{"type":"qtqd"}`;
        charts.push(chart);
    })
})
charts;
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.java.util 
);
with(javaImport){
    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束

saybody=java.getString("$.sayBody");
say=saybody!=""?"\n作者有话要说：\n"+saybody:"";

result=String(decode(content)+say);

var contentParts = [];

    var encoded = match[1];
    // Base64 解码
    var decoded = java.base64Decode(encoded);
    if (decoded) {
        contentParts.push(decoded);
    }
}
// 拼接并处理 HTML 实体
var content = contentParts.join('');
// 解码常见的 HTML 实体
content = content.replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/"/g, '"');
result = content;

if (!bes) {
    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString("#txt@html");
    java.longToast("正文解密失败，转为webView动态加载。");
} else {
var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {
    // 遍历数组，使用阅读内置Base64解码方法
    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
	var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;
</js>

var javaImport = new JavaImporter();
javaImport.importPackage(
     Packages.java.lang,
    Packages.javax.crypto.spec,
    Packages.javax.crypto,
    Packages.android.util  
);
with(javaImport){
function encryptByDES(massage, keydata) {
        let cipher = Cipher.getInstance("DES");
        let keySpec = new DESKeySpec(String(keydata).getBytes());
         let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
         let key = keyFactory.generateSecret(keySpec);      
        cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key);
        return Base64.encodeToString(cipher.doFinal(String(massage).getBytes()),Base64.NO_WRAP)
}
}
//DES加密结束
